title: SEC7: contact.rs line 226 — error path after .collect() untested
description: get_changes_since() line 223-227: the .collect() call after .query_map() is theoretically fragile. If row mapping fails (panics), the error is caught and returned. However, no test covers this error path. The risk is low (the row mapping is simple), but the design creates an untested code path. Consider restructuring to use explicit iteration with error handling, or add a test that verifies error handling under failure conditions.
